ordering.external_coordinator_first: Alchemy joins the existing coordinator and does not install another physical wrapper.
ordering.alchemy_first: Alchemy keeps its direct wrapper; a later coordinator may wrap and later restore that exact object method.
ordering.unsafe_direct_release: Alchemy refuses to remove its direct layer while an outer coordinator remains active.

security.instrument_mutations: INSTRUMENTMETHOD, INSTRUMENTREGISTEREDMETHODS and UNINSTRUMENTMETHOD are PROTECTED.
security.callback_authority: An opaque per-object identity token is required by the public callback bridge.
security.coordinator_trust: Protocol presence is instrumentation compatibility evidence, not execution authority or cryptographic trust.
